section_summary.extract_value: This section details the data analysis procedures, which involved using IBM SPSS Statistics 22.0 and AMOS for path analyses. Descriptive statistics and Pearson product-moment correlations were conducted to examine relationships between variables such as BMI, body image discrepancy, body image-related cognitive fusion, body appreciation (BAS-2), and disordered eating attitudes. Path analysis was used to assess the predictive relationships among these variables, with significance examined using Bootstrap resampling.
